stories.title: Asia stocks slide as Taiwan drops 4%, AI jitters dim Anthropic IPO cheer
stories.summary: Asian equity markets fell broadly, with Taiwan's benchmark index down 4%. Investor worry about AI-sector valuations spread across the region and overshadowed positive sentiment from Anthropic's IPO. Tech-heavy markets took the biggest hit.
stories.whyItMatters: A region-wide sell-off tied to AI valuation fears signals nerves that could spread to US and European tech stocks.
whatToWatch: Whether the sell-off spreads to US and European markets
Further moves in Taiwan's tech-heavy index
questions: How much of the drop is Taiwan-specific versus a broader AI pullback?
Does Anthropic's IPO strength offset wider AI valuation worries?

stories.whyItMatters: Any US-China talk touching Nvidia's leadership feeds broader concerns about chip export policy and tech tensions between the two countries.

questions: What exactly was discussed about Huang's situation?

stories.title: Anthropic raises record $81 billion in IPO at $1.5 trillion valuation
stories.summary: Anthropic completed an initial public offering that raised $81 billion, a record sum, valuing the AI company at $1.5 trillion. The listing ranks among the largest public debuts in the AI industry's history.
stories.whyItMatters: The deal's size sets a new benchmark for AI company valuations and signals investor appetite for the sector, even as other AI-linked stocks wobble elsewhere in Asia.
whatToWatch: Anthropic's stock performance in initial trading
Whether the valuation holds amid broader AI valuation worries
questions: How does Anthropic justify a $1.5 trillion valuation relative to its revenue?
